regime_context: Hong Kong theme landscape is narrow and defensive: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible (Banks, Energy, High-Dividend, Conglomerates), and Banks lead with a crowded, mean-reverting profile. theses.thesis: Energy is the only eligible challenger with a clean trend tag (hurst_tag='trend') and non-crowded positioning (crowding_z=0.24), while Banks — the leader — is mean-reverting and crowded. theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
